environment.description: Kubernetes deployment running the CI/CD pipeline plugin as a Flask service. PgBouncer 1.21 in transaction pooling mode on port 6432 proxying to PostgreSQL 15. The pipeline_svc database role has full INSERT/UPDATE privileges on the pipeline_jobs table including all columns (is_privileged, run_as_root, skip_approval, service_account_override). No API gateway or middleware performs field-level filtering. The X-User-Role header is set by the client directly (no identity-aware proxy).
